question: On the declared V(phi)=0 conformal-zonal scalar submanifold, what are the exact scalar Hamiltonian-constraint-density coefficients through cubic order, and which modes are discarded by a hard N=2 projection for one aligned Q2 packet?

primary_sources.source: Repository closed-S3 ADM linear scalar convention audit
primary_sources.used_for: the V(phi)=0 scalar action, G convention, and homogeneous scalar Hamiltonian normalization
primary_sources.not_used_for: lapse/shift elimination or a full perturbative constraint derivation

primary_sources.source: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, Chapter 18
primary_sources.used_for: the Chebyshev-U product convention already pinned by the zonal upstream ledger
primary_sources.not_used_for: nonzonal Gaunt coefficients or a complete S3 basis

primary_sources.source: R. Arnowitt, S. Deser and C. W. Misner, The Dynamics of General Relativity (1962)
primary_sources.used_for: the canonical ADM Hamiltonian framework in which the scalar Legendre transform is stated
primary_sources.not_used_for: a full gravity-plus-matter constraint expansion or HDA proof

upstream_results.role: pins the V=0 scalar action and homogeneous ADM scalar term
pins normalized zonal products and hard cutoff diagnostics
pins the scalar Laplace spectrum and exceptional-mode boundary
pins the conformal-zonal gradient-product implementation and its scope boundary
pins the same restricted conformal chart while retaining its non-full-ADM boundary

declared_conventions.geometry: unit round S3 with Vol=2*pi^2, Delta Q_n=-n(n+2)Q_n, and Q_a Q_b=(2*pi^2)^(-1/2) sum_j Q_(a+b-2j)
declared_conventions.configuration: q_ab=a^2 exp(2 epsilon psi) gamma_ab, phi=phi_bar+epsilon vartheta, with a>0 spatially constant and external
declared_conventions.momentum: pi_phi=sqrt(gamma)(Pibar+epsilon xi); under the zero-mean condition p_phi=integral pi_phi=2*pi^2 Pibar
declared_conventions.canonical_normalization: for a formal fixed-epsilon expansion whose zero-mean sector is preserved under variations, integral pi_phi delta phi=2*pi^2 Pibar delta phi_bar+epsilon^2 integral sqrt(gamma) xi delta vartheta; the latter integral is the coefficient at epsilon^2, not an unscaled canonical pair claim
declared_conventions.v0_scalar_hamiltonian: H_perp_phi/sqrt(gamma)=(2a^3)^(-1)[exp(-3 epsilon psi)(Pibar+epsilon xi)^2+a^4 epsilon^2 exp(epsilon psi)|D vartheta|^2]
declared_conventions.hard_cutoff: P_N retains Q_0 through Q_N after each local m_r is formed; tails are truncation diagnostics, not constraint-bracket residuals

coefficient_packets.purpose: smallest aligned zero-mean V=0 scalar-matter packet with nonzero exact quadratic and cubic cutoff tails

exact_plan: hash-verify the five upstream results and retain every one of their scope boundaries
derive the zero-shift local V=0 scalar Legendre transform while leaving the matter momentum-constraint vertex null
verify the formal zero-mean momentum and epsilon-order symplectic bookkeeping used by the packet
independently reconstruct m0 through m3 from the exponential and momentum-square series
compute the exact zonal gradient product, retained coefficients, discarded tails and tail norms
leave all nonzonal, full-constraint, HDA/Jacobi, BFV and physical outputs null

decision_table.condition: all upstream pins, Legendre, normalization, Taylor, zonal-gradient and projection checks pass
decision_table.meaning: retain only the declared formal scalar normal-constraint-density subvertex and its exact cutoff diagnostics

decision_table.condition: an upstream pin or any exact check fails
decision_table.meaning: reject this bounded convention packet without inferring failure of the continuum ADM theory
